Maya: Morning team — quick thread for tomorrow's release train (09:00–11:00 PT). Need final owner for service-embed canary. @Devon can you take it?
Devon: I got it. Plan to kick canary at 09:15. Will coordinate DB backfill with @Lucas. :thumbsup: 
Lucas: I'll run the backfill at 09:20. It's read-only index backfill; ran on staging, ~3–4m. DM me 15m prior to throttle concurrency.
Rebecca: I'll do smoke verification for embed: happy-path, ratelimit, auth. Can someone paste the smoke checklist into the runbook?
Maya: Minimal handoff checklist — copy into runbook and drop screenshots & metrics here:
```
- announce in #eng-releases
- deploy canary to 2 nodes
- smoke endpoints: /smoke/embed/happy, /smoke/embed/ratelimit, /smoke/embed/auth
- monitor p50/p95 and error-rate for 10m
- ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 100% if green
- rollback tag ready: service-embed@rollback
- paste runbook links + screenshots
```
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved 09:15—09:25 PT for service-embed. Runway 09:00–11:00.
Samir: I'll own rollback. Image baked: service-embed:rollback-2026-03-17. Logs at logs.redwood/release/service-embed.
Devon: PR #4321 merged; build 20260317-embed-98 passed CI. Command:
```
./deploy.sh service-embed --env=prod --canary=2 --tag=20260317-embed-98
```
Rebecca: Quick smoke commands:
```
curl -f -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/embed -d '{"text":"smoke"}'
curl -f https://api.redwood.dev/embed?rate=high
curl -f -H 'Authorization: Bearer BAD' https://api.redwood.dev/embed
```
Maya: Two checks before lock: 1) any feature flags touching embeddings? 2) other migrations in same train that could conflict?
Lucas: Only other migration is payment-service index at 10:05 — separate table, no block.
Devon: No FF flips from embed side. We'll coordinate if needed.
Rebecca: I'll post smoke pass/fail and metrics (p50/p95, error-rate). On fail -> tag rollback & ping Samir.
Maya: Final cadence:
- 09:00 kickoff (this channel)
- 09:10 pre-deploy checks
- 09:15 canary deploy (Devon)
- 09:20 smoke (Rebecca)
- 09:30 ramp to full if green
- 10:00 payment FF flip (Lucas)
React :thumbsup: to confirm and include ETA.
Devon: +1 owner, prechecks ready 09:05. :eyes: 
Lucas: +1 migration, I'll be oncall 09:10—09:30. :ok_hand: 
Samir: +1 rollback coverage, monitoring logs. :shield: 
deploy-bot: Reminder set — 30m before canary (08:45 PT). Good luck!
